Voter ID (India).question: What is Voter ID (India)? Indian identity document.
Voter ID (India).fact: The Indian Voter Card, officially the Elector's Photo Identity Card (EPIC), is an identity document issued by the Election Commission of India to all Indian citizens who have reached the age of 18.   It primarily serves as an identity proof for casting their ballot in the country's municipal, state, and national elections.
